body: checkRevenuePriority() added to PLAN phase: scans last 25 completion Apples for revenue keywords (steam, ask_emily, emily+, subscription, launch, etc.). When found, bumps priority-5 on queued S19/S20/S21 roadmap items. Run inline (not goroutine) so priority changes are visible to pickTask() in next DECIDE phase. Resolves AGI Gap 3 (revenue signals don't feed RSI priority).
title: S27-05: revenue signal → RSI priority wiring in cron.go
